scope: Proposition 2.3 of the manuscript “Unrestricted pro-modularity at the prime two” (preprints/Unrestricted-pro-modularity-at-the-prime-two-October-6-2026/two-adic-promodularity.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 010 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ef74b48557930663), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let B be the family in Lemma 2.2, with the normalized determinant of Lemma 2.1. There is a solvable totally real Galois extension F/Q, of even degree and completely split at 2, such that the closed trace image of B|GF is pro-modular at one fixed tame level and central character ψ|GF . This assertion includes scalar and reducible semisimple residual representations.
